description: Apply article 152A of the Companies Law Cap. 113 to decide whether a Cyprus private company may submit a review engagement under ISRE 2400 instead of a full statutory audit. There is no audit exemption in Cyprus; this tests a substitution.

gross_assets.description: Total value of assets without deducting liabilities.

group_exceeds_limits_on_aggregate.description: True if the group exceeds the turnover or asset thresholds measured on aggregate rather than company by company.

net_turnover.description: Net turnover including rental, interest, dividend and royalty income.

prepares_or_is_in_consolidated_accounts.description: True if the company prepares consolidated financial statements, or is itself included in another company’s. Either one removes the relief whatever the size.

within_limits_for_two_consecutive_years.description: True if net turnover and gross assets were both under the thresholds in each of two consecutive financial years. One year on its own is not enough.

name: cyprus_audit_or_review_test
title: Test whether a review may replace a full audit
